data.group: Daemon Prince of Tzeentch with Wings
data.summary: For each attack this Daemon Prince makes, you may reroll its [Hit and Wound results](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) of 1. Against a **CHARACTER** or **PSYKER** unit you may reroll both rolls in full. When the Prince destroys a **CHARACTER** unit, heal D3 lost wounds at most. Raise that cap to 3 instead for a **PSYKER** unit the Prince destroys.
